MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    n = int(input()) * 2
    # Initialize 3D DP array with dimensions (n+1) x (n+1) x 2, default value 0
    dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n+1)] for _ in range(n+1)]
    
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for h in range(0, i+1):
            if (i - h) % 2 != 0:
                continue
            if h + 1 <= i - 1:
                dp[i][h][0] = (dp[i - 1][h + 1][1] + 1) % MOD
                dp[i][h][1] = dp[i - 1][h + 1][0]
                if h > 0:
                    dp[i][h][0] = (dp[i][h][0] + dp[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD
                    dp[i][h][1] = (dp[i][h][1] + dp[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD
            else:
                dp[i][h][0] = (dp[i - 1][h - 1][1] + 1) % MOD
                dp[i][h][1] = dp[i - 1][h - 1][0]
    print(dp[n][0][0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
